title: Dawson Hollow
seo_title: Dawson Hollow Live at Connect2Culture in Joplin, MO
description: Dawson Hollow is an indie folk-rock band formed by five siblings from the Ozark Mountains of Missouri, and this is a live music performance by the group. The summary describes their sound as a blend of cinematic indie-pop and Americana influences. It takes place Saturday, February 20, 2027, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM at Connect2Culture at the Cornell Complex, 212 West 7th Street, Joplin, MO.
